children: Hycroft Mining Holding reported high-grade drill results with Vortex returning 30.5m at 780.53 g/t silver and Brimstone 5.5m at 1,345.27 g/t silver.
Vortex H26D-6090: 30.5m at 780.53 g/t Ag and 0.49 g/t Au, including 11.2m at 1,664.80 g/t Ag.
Vortex H26D-6166: 20.0m at 460.82 g/t Ag, including 6.1m at 952.37 g/t Ag and 1.6m at 2,650.00 g/t Ag.
Vortex H26D-6172: 6.1m at 28.65 g/t Ag and 21.12 g/t Au, including 1.5m at 43.00 g/t Au — follow-up drilling planned.
Brimstone H26D-6167A: 5.5m at 1,345.27 g/t Ag, including 1.8m at 4,074.00 g/t Ag, opening additional target opportunities.
Company says mineralization remains open in multiple directions, supporting potential for expansion of high-grade underground zones.
